title: How to Plan a Useful Local Camera Dashboard
seo_title: Local Camera Dashboard | A Practical Planning Guide
description: Plan a local camera dashboard around the views, device status, failures and handoff details you need, without turning one screen into another source of clutter.
excerpt: A useful camera dashboard is not a wall of tiny video tiles. Start with the decisions the screen must support, then plan views, status, failure states and a maintainable handoff.
